references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, turtle doves or young pigeons are mentioned as an offering for those who cannot afford a lamb, and the expression 'as his hand can reach' is used.
The same wording about offering a turtle dove or young pigeons according to one's means is used for the sin offering of the poor.
It shows the principle that the poor may bring a less costly offering according to their ability.
The same principle regarding a turtle dove or young pigeon as an offering when one cannot afford a lamb, used in purification after childbirth.
Turtle doves and young pigeons are mentioned as acceptable bird offerings to the Lord.
Mary and Joseph brought a pair of turtle doves as an offering at Jesus' presentation in the temple, showing that they followed the provision for the poor.
